breaks.what: with-critic phase_flow: verify, queue and merge are not comparable between rows with no phase_flow and with-critic rows after it
a clean-rebase push row joins its gated head: integrate and its with-critic flow are read on landings that read n/a and standalone before
a landing whose first gate run is inside its final integration run: verify reads a measured 0 (was invalid) and implement ends at the run's start

a re-dispatch from Parked restarts the dispatch stamp, and after a recorded restart implement ends at the first gate run at or after it: implement reads measured (was invalid) and excludes the parked span
a later landing of an already-landed ticket starts implement at its follow-up ticket.dispatched, else at the previous landing, not the first dispatch stamp
